title: Implant starts working after Anne's death and spells out 'it's me'

tellings.quote: And the words slow down and it says very clearly coming across, it's me and

plain: Whitley Strieber, a writer known for describing his own encounters with beings he believes are not human, told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about something that happened after the death of Anne Strieber, around 2015. He says an implant, a tiny object he believes was put in his body during his encounters, began working, and that words came through it, slowing down until they clearly said "it's me." He tells it as a sign that Anne was reaching him after her death.
